tools.description: Read NVMe SMART health (temperature, spare, wear, media errors) with a good/warning/critical grade per drive. Never records a measurement; use `symcockpit storage health` for that.
tools.name: get_storage_health

tools.description: Recorded SMART measurements, newest first, with what changed between them.

device.description: Device key as printed by get_storage_health (`location:model`); default all.

limit.description: How many measurements to return, newest first (1–1000, default 20).

tools.name: get_storage_health_history

tools.description: Measure sequential read/write speed of a folder with a temporary file (removed afterwards). The folder must be under the home directory or /Volumes; at most 1024 MiB.

cache_mode.description: uncached (default) asks the OS to bypass its file cache (F_NOCACHE).

path.description: Directory to test; must be under the home directory or /Volumes (default: home).

size_mib.description: Test file size in MiB (2^20 bytes), 1–1024, default 256.

tools.name: run_speedtest

tools.description: Size tree of a folder: the largest children per level and what is left in other.

depth.description: Levels of the tree to return (1–16, default 2).

limit.description: Largest children kept per directory (1–200, default 10).

tools.name: analyze_space

tools.description: Scan the cleanup catalog (user caches, logs, Xcode derived data, optionally the Trash) and record a plan. Nothing is deleted until confirm_plan runs it.

categories.description: Catalog categories to scan; default: all except empty_trash.

tools.name: plan_clean

tools.description: Find files with identical content under a folder (read-only).

min_size.description: Ignore files smaller than this many bytes (default 1).

tools.name: find_duplicates

tools.description: Record a plan that moves the selected duplicate files to the Trash; every group keeps at least one copy. Run it with confirm_plan.

min_size.description: Ignore files smaller than this many bytes (default 1).

select.description: Files to move to the Trash; every group keeps at least one copy.

tools.name: plan_remove_duplicates

tools.description: Record a plan that moves an app and the files it owns to the Trash. Documents are never included. Run it with confirm_plan.

app.description: Path of the .app bundle or its bundle id.

tools.name: plan_uninstall_app

tools.description: Show a recorded plan: items, totals, expiry and, once confirmed, the results.

plan_id.description: Id of a plan, as returned by a plan_* tool.

tools.name: get_plan

tools.description: Run a recorded plan once. Every item is checked against its recorded identity first and reports confirmed, unconfirmed, failed, unsupported or skipped_changed.

plan_id.description: Id of a plan, as returned by a plan_* tool.

tools.name: confirm_plan

tools.description: List audio devices with default input/output, volume, mute and format.
tools.name: list_audio_devices

tools.description: Read one audio device by its stable UID.

uid.description: Stable device UID as listed by list_audio_devices.

tools.name: get_audio_device

tools.description: List MIDI devices with their sources and destinations.
tools.name: list_midi_devices

tools.description: Make an audio device the default input or output. Reads the setting back.

uid.description: Stable device UID as listed by list_audio_devices.

tools.name: set_default_audio_device

tools.description: Set the volume (0.0–1.0) of an audio device. Reads the value back.

direction.description: Which side of the device; default: output if it has the control, else input.

uid.description: Stable device UID as listed by list_audio_devices.

tools.name: set_audio_volume

tools.description: Mute or unmute an audio device. Reads the state back.

direction.description: Which side of the device; default: output if it has the control, else input.

uid.description: Stable device UID as listed by list_audio_devices.

tools.name: set_audio_mute

tools.description: Set the volume of one app that plays audio. Needs a running mixer (the Cockpit app); a one-shot server has none and answers unsupported.

app.description: Process id or bundle identifier of an app that plays audio.

tools.name: set_audio_app_volume

tools.description: Record a plan that changes the sample rate and bit depth of an audio device. Run it with confirm_plan.

bits.description: Bits per sample; omit to change the rate only.

uid.description: Stable device UID as listed by list_audio_devices.

tools.name: plan_audio_format

tools.description: Record a plan that creates an aggregate or multi-output audio device. Run it with confirm_plan.

main.description: Clock source UID; default: the first member.

multi_output.description: Play the same audio on every member.

tools.name: plan_audio_aggregate

tools.description: List paired Bluetooth devices with connection state and battery level.
tools.name: list_bluetooth_devices

tools.description: Scan for Bluetooth LE devices for a few seconds. Never connects or disconnects anything.

filter.description: Shows only devices whose name, id or service matches. Never disconnects.

tools.name: scan_ble

tools.description: Connect to a BLE device, read one GATT characteristic and disconnect.
tools.name: read_ble_characteristic

tools.description: Record a plan that writes bytes to a BLE characteristic. Run it with confirm_plan; the result states acknowledgement and readback separately.

value_hex.description: Bytes to write as hex, 1 to 512 bytes.

with_response.description: Write with response (default true): the peripheral acknowledges.

tools.name: plan_ble_write

tools.description: Record a plan that ends a process with SIGTERM. The plan holds its start time and path; confirm_plan skips it if the id now belongs to another process and reports whether it really exited.

pid.description: Process id to end with SIGTERM. The plan records its start time and path; confirm_plan skips it if another process reused the id.

tools.name: plan_kill_process
